valuation_snapshot.valuation_anchor_summary: Historical financial statement analysis uses audited FY25 annual actuals (ended 31 March 2025). Capitalization, CMP, and peer comparisons reflect the October 2025 market pricing snapshot captured in originals/Marksans Keshav.xlsx (retrieval date recorded as 2025-10-05; trade observation date inferred without primary exchange confirmation).

methodology_notes.nifty_50_market_return: Sheet RM!F10 (15.15%) is the 26-year (2000-2025) arithmetic average of annual percentage returns of the Nifty 50 Price Return (PR) index present in the template. Because the PR index excludes dividends, adding the 1.22% dividend yield assumption (RM!F11) yields Rm = 16.37% (arithmetic average). Primary NSE historical index time-series logs are not separately uploaded in originals/.
methodology_notes.peer_median_capital_structure: Target debt weight (2.24%) and equity weight (97.76%) are derived from the median capital structure of five listed peers (Sun Pharma, Divi's, Torrent, Zydus, Laurus) in WACC-DCF!H18. This represents an institutional modeling choice following Damodaran pure-play valuation guidelines rather than an absolute empirical fact.

deliberate_exceptions.exception: Trailing Fiscal Year vs Market Pricing Cutoff
deliberate_exceptions.rationale: Balance sheet debt (Rs 343.38 Cr) and cash (Rs 704.21 Cr) are anchored at FY25 balance sheet audit date (2025-03-31), whereas Market Cap (Rs 14,002.74 Cr) reflects the October 2025 market price. This is institutional corporate finance standard practice (using trailing audited balance sheet with prevailing market value equity).
deliberate_exceptions.effect: Current debt/equity ratio (2.39% debt / 97.61% equity) reflects prevailing market capitalization against audited debt book value.

deliberate_exceptions.exception: Target vs Current Capital Structure in DCF Discounting
deliberate_exceptions.rationale: Per Damodaran valuation methodology, the DCF model discounts future free cash flows at the target peer-median capital structure (2.24% debt / 97.76% equity) rather than current capital structure (2.39% debt / 97.61% equity).
deliberate_exceptions.effect: Target WACC is 12.11%, whereas current-weighted WACC would be 12.10% (0.01% / 1 bp difference).

entries.label: Risk-Free Rate (Rf)
entries.derivation_details: Benchmark 10-Year Indian Government Bond (G-Sec) yield as of valuation snapshot date.
entries.verification_notes: Sourced market input present in template WACC-DCF!J22 tagged '(Latest)'; primary RBI/CCIL trade log not uploaded.

entries.label: Total Market Return (Rm)
entries.derivation_details: Arithmetic average of 26 annual Nifty 50 returns (2000-2025, RM!F10=15.15%) + assumed dividend yield (RM!F11=1.22%): 15.1492% + 1.2200% = 16.3692%.
entries.verification_notes: Hybrid: 26 annual return observations are historical facts; 1.22% dividend yield is an analyst constant assumption.

entries.label: Equity Risk Premium (ERP)
entries.verification_notes: Exact model identity evaluated from RM!F12 and WACC-DCF!J22.

entries.label: Peer Comps Median Unlevered Beta
entries.derivation_details: Median of unlevered betas across 5 pharmaceutical peers in WACC-DCF: Sun Pharma (0.538), Divi's (0.901), Torrent (0.462), Zydus (0.476), Laurus (1.053). Unlevered beta = Levered Beta / [1 + (1 - Tax) * (D/E)]. Median is 0.537891 (Sun Pharma).
entries.verification_notes: Exact peer aggregation derived from peerdata G5:G9 and E5:E9.

entries.label: Target Debt-to-Equity Ratio
entries.derivation_details: Target Debt Weight / Target Equity Weight = 0.022398 / 0.977602 = 0.022911.

entries.label: Target Levered Beta (Hamada)
entries.verification_notes: Re-levered pure-play beta. Replaces single-stock raw regression beta (1.208) per Damodaran valuation standard.

entries.label: Cost of Equity (Ke)
entries.verification_notes: Evaluated with unrounded floats. Discrepancy in earlier report was caused by manual rounded-string substitution (0.547 * 9.07% vs 0.546518 * 9.06923%).

entries.label: Pre-tax Cost of Debt
entries.derivation_details: Forward-looking marginal corporate borrowing rate assumption of 8.00%.
entries.verification_notes: Analyst assumption. Historical effective interest (Interest / Borrowings = 11.66 / 321.91 = 3.62%) reflects subsidized export credit, not marginal replacement borrowing cost.

entries.label: Marginal Corporate Tax Rate
entries.derivation_details: Indian marginal statutory corporate income tax rate (base 25% + statutory surcharge + health/education cess ~= 30.00%).
entries.verification_notes: Sourced statutory benchmark. WACC-DCF!B36 note 1 confirms country marginal tax rate.

entries.label: Total Debt / Borrowings (Current)
entries.derivation_details: Short-term plus long-term borrowings from Screener.in balance sheet data as of FY25 present in template.
entries.verification_notes: Total debt from template Data Sheet!K59 / BS!H20; primary statutory annual report filing not separately uploaded.

entries.label: Market Capitalisation (Current)
entries.derivation_details: Total shares (453,163,746) * CMP (Rs 309.10) = Rs 14,002.74 Cr as of market snapshot date.
entries.verification_notes: Calculated as CMP (Rs 309.10) * 453.16M shares. CMP is an inherited template snapshot value from Sunday 2025-10-05 Screener capture.

entries.label: Target Weight of Debt (Peer Median)
entries.derivation_details: Peer median of Debt / (Debt + Equity) across Sun Pharma (1.08%), Divi's (0.00%), Torrent (7.91%), Zydus (10.11%), and Laurus (2.24%). Median is 2.2398% (Laurus Labs).
entries.verification_notes: Used directly in DCF WACC weighting. Represents an institutional modeling choice following Damodaran pure-play methodology, distinct from current book debt weight (2.39%).

entries.label: Target Weight of Equity (Peer Median)
entries.verification_notes: Used directly in DCF WACC weighting. Represents an institutional modeling choice following Damodaran pure-play methodology, distinct from current market equity weight (97.61%).
